summary: The Quantum Informatics Centre for Doctoral Training is recruiting Cohort 3 of PhD students for 2027/28 entry, with applications made through the University of Edinburgh. It is for graduates in a relevant subject who want doctoral training in quantum informatics. Applications opened in October 2026 and close on 7 January 2027; interviews take place in late March and offers follow in mid-April 2027.
highlights: At minimum a UK first-class or upper second-class (2:1) honours degree, or equivalent, in a relevant subject.
Apply through the University of Edinburgh's EUCLID system.
Interviews in late March; offers in mid-April 2027.
Application status not yet confirmed: verify the dates and requirements on the official Quantum Informatics CDT page before applying.
